command: ProxyCommand=ssh -p 2222 -i /Users/rei/.ssh/id_ed25519 -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 -W %h:%p reiwatanabe@casper.ai.hc.keio.ac.jp
